title: The Forever Almanac
tagline: Routes, ladders and trainers for WoW: Forever, true as of the date on each page.
footerNote: Forever launched 4 Nov 2026. Every page says which of its claims are solid, which to check in game, and which are still guesswork. Nothing here is filled in from vanilla or TBC.
